# Win10min — Win 10 Minutes

> Win10min is a gamified focus timer for iPhone and a separate Mac app available on the App Store. Completed focus sessions contribute to Roman progress. The apps have different features; progress, settings and purchases do not sync.

## Official product information

- [Win10min homepage](https://win10minutes.app/): current downloads, device requirements, setup questions and platform differences.
- [Ten-minute focus guide](https://win10minutes.app/guides/ten-minute-focus/): a practical routine, iPhone Screen Time setup, Mac app hiding and optional ChatGPT planning.
- [iPhone App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6751601664): current iPhone release, compatibility and in-app purchase information.
- [Mac App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/win-10-minutes/id6821235537): current Mac release and compatibility information.
- [Privacy policy](https://win10minutes.app/privacy): published data-handling policy.
- [Terms of use](https://win10minutes.app/terms): published terms.

- [Mac focus timer setup](https://win10minutes.app/guides/mac-focus-timer/): App Store installation, optional ChatGPT planning, app hiding and troubleshooting.
- [iPhone focus and App Limits setup](https://win10minutes.app/guides/iphone-focus-and-app-limits/): Screen Time permissions, focus sessions, Daily App Limits and purchase restoration.

## Platform boundaries

The iPhone app uses Apple Screen Time app blocking and includes empire campaigns, focus statistics and Arena. It is free to download with in-app purchases; local prices and included features are shown by Apple and the app.

Win 10 Minutes for Mac requires Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) and macOS 26 or later. It supports app-window hiding and saves Roman progress. See the Mac focus timer setup guide for the optional Win10min Planner workflow. It does not block websites, lock applications, support Intel or Windows, or provide the iPhone Arena.

The timer records time, not proof of task completion. No medical outcomes, guaranteed productivity gains, rankings or review ratings are claimed here. Unreleased iPhone code is not a public feature specification.

- [Free 10 minute timer](https://win10minutes.app/tools/10-minute-timer/): browser countdown with optional chime and focus view; no signup. No account sync, app blocking or saved session history.
